name: labs/qte77__i3mega-pipettebot
title: Anycubic i3 Mega pipettebot gantry
intro: Anycubic i3 Mega pipettebot gantry, adapted from qte77/i3mega-pipettebot. It reads `x`, `y` and `z`; runs `move_to`, `home` and `emergency_stop`. `move_to`: move the tool centre point to a Cartesian position and orientation in a named frame. The endpoint solves inverse kinematics; an unreachable target is rejected before motion. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
